components.name: Signal Observatory
components.description: Machined transformer cutaway with explicit direction, layer identity and selectable component ports.

narrative.overview: A scientific survey of language models: clear chart fields establish orientation, while abyssal cutaways reveal mechanism, evidence, and implementation. Every layer and marker encodes a real relationship.

rules.name: The Encoded Color Rule
rules.body: Pigment identifies a layer, state, or path; it is never scattered merely to create energy.

rules.name: The Instrument Test
rules.body: Monospace belongs only to measurements, coordinates, code, identifiers, and evidence.

rules.name: The Measured Depth Rule
rules.body: Every visual layer corresponds to curriculum order, model structure, interaction state, or evidence priority.

dos: Do let one structural cutaway or path dominate each major surface.
Do derive diagrams from real product relationships.
Do treat mobile as a deliberate vertical survey.
Do keep every explorer selector mapped to a numbered observatory port and an honest physical mechanism.
donts: Don't use cartographic marks as wallpaper.
Don't use generic AI neon or robot imagery.
Don't rasterize core interface text or controls.
